goal: Establish canonical version, supersession, migration, and retirement governance while reducing the active legacy surface and preserving the single Provider and delivery mainline.
acceptance_criteria: One current architecture registry names the factual active authorities and canonical routes.
One deterministic retirement gate fails closed on duplicate authority, expired compatibility, superseded production references, legacy producers, stale current documentation, and version mismatch.
Compatibility surfaces are read-only projections or importers with explicit allowed consumers and remove_in versions.
Superseded implementation is removed or isolated from the active surface after consumer migration is verified.
Generated and maintained projects receive complexity-tailored supersession and retirement rules without a second generation path.
Scoped regressions and kernel contract pass; formal quick profile is bounded and reported truthfully.

quality_metrics.target: 0 or 1, with every required authority exactly 1
quality_metrics.method: canonical version gate and negative tests

quality_metrics.measure: superseded production imports and compatibility producers
version mismatches and stale current documentation references
protected requirement, Provider, evidence, packaging, and delivery regressions

prevention: Use one data registry and one gate instead of manager abstractions
assurance: Review authority and schema ownership against the contract registry
control: Run retirement, requirement, component, Provider, packaging, delivery, kernel, and bounded quick profiles
improvement: Remove obsolete active surfaces and keep historical detail in Git

interface_expectations: Task Understanding remains the GoalSpec authority and clarification stays unassigned
ProviderJob remains the only project-work concurrency unit
ArtifactInstance and ComponentExecution remain the execution truth
formal evidence, acceptance, promotion, local_packager, and public delivery authorities remain unchanged

feedback: The canonical version gate and all scoped requirement, Component, ProviderJob, packaging, delivery, and kernel regressions passed.
Seven superseded generation source files and four historical-contract test files were removed from the active tree.

The formal quick profile completed with 1830 passed, 21 failed, 16 errors, and 440 deselected in 898.65 seconds; repository-global evidence remains NEEDS_REWORK because unrelated baseline failures persist.

worked: Replacing legacy-label checks with absence checks made retirement enforceable.
One data registry and one deterministic gate covered authority, compatibility, imports, producers, documentation, and version truth without manager abstractions.
Scoped and repository-global verdicts remained separate.
did_not_work: The repository-wide quick profile remains near its 900-second bound and contains unrelated baseline failures and fixture errors.
experiments: Repair the independent quick-profile baseline as a separate backlog item without weakening the canonical retirement gate.
